notes.title: Development Update: A New Focus
notes.notes:
Dear LithoBreak Community,

We hope this message finds you well. We want to take a moment to thank each and every one of you for your continued support and enthusiasm for LithoBreak. Your feedback and engagement have been invaluable to us as we work to make this game the best it can be.


Pause on Episode Development

We have an important update to share regarding the development of Episode 1 and future episodes.

After careful consideration, we’ve decided to temporarily offload work on the episodes during early access. This means that while we have updated the Steam 'default' branch to include multiplayer functionality, it does not include Episode 1 content.

We understand that this news may be disappointing, knowing most of you have enjoyed Episode 1 and are eagerly awaiting Episode 2. However, we believe this decision will ultimately benefit the game and the community in the long run. By focusing on completing and polishing the core gameplay loop, we can ensure a more robust and engaging experience for everyone in all game modes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38362143/ae7bbc6e9fe673de50d2c736ad79501e17f9827a.png


Why This Change?
[olist]
 Improved Story Content: When we reintroduce the story content, it will be refreshed and be built atop a solid foundation of core gameplay mechanics. This allows us more creative freedom and ensures a seamless experience.
 Resource Efficiency: Maintaining Episode 1 through development is resource-intensive for our small team. Offloading this work allows us to focus our efforts on enhancing the core gameplay and adding new features.
 Access to Original Episode 1: For those who wish to experience the original Episode 1, we’ve added an 'ogepisode1' branch on Steam. This way, you can still enjoy the story content while we work on bringing you an even better experience in the future.
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38362143/ef023a5ba99380cc4526d64ea3e30b7942327d40.png


Current Development Focus

Here’s an update on where we are at and what we’re working on:

 Multiplayer Testing: We’ve recently completed a round of testing, open to everyone who had purchased LithoBreak, to validate that multiplayer functionality works seamlessly. Thank you to everyone who participated in this testing phase!
 First-Person Mechanics: In direct response to the feedback received through the multiplayer testing, we’re adding more first-person mechanics to give multiplayer gameplay more depth and meaning. This includes animated character models and Gadgets (holdable and useable items) that players can utilize.
 Community Poll for Next Gadget: We’re excited to involve you in the development process! We are hosting a week-long community poll to decide what the next Gadget should be over on Discord.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38362143/d90968af1501440d627d471c9bccc6af8c34fa58.png


Looking Ahead

While this shift in focus may be challenging in the short term, we are confident that it will lead to a more polished and enjoyable game for all. We appreciate your understanding and patience as we make these necessary adjustments. Your feedback and support are crucial to us, and we encourage you to share your thoughts and ideas.

Following the Gadgets mechanics will come the much anticipated Custom Buildings and Custom Vehicles, so stay tuned for that!

Thank you for being a part of the LithoBreak journey. Together, we can create something truly special.

Warm regards,

The LithoBreak Development Team

notes.title: May Video Update
notes.notes:
Greetings LithoBreak Community!
We're back with our May monthly video update, bringing you the latest on our game development progress. This month's highlights include:

Standardizing Parts:
We've started reshaping our parts to standardize them across equipment, reducing the number of unique parts and aligning them with hexagon grids. This makes parts more versatile and gameplay more streamlined.

Grid System Expansion:
We've expanded our grid system, introducing nested grids of different sizes - 1m, 3m, and 9m. This new system will simplify gameplay from personal item placement to configuring larger equipment.

Material Transfer Mechanism:
We've developed a material transfer mechanism that allows efficient material movement between equipment pieces, utilizing our new hexagonal grid system. Watch the video to see how it works in action.

State Machines for Equipment:
We're transitioning our equipment systems over to state machines, making them easier to maintain and improving game performance.

[previewyoutube=x2xthzfEhJY;full][/previewyoutube]

We continue to appreciate your support and feedback. We invite you to join our community discussions here on Steam and on our social media channels (Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn).

Happy building, and see you on the moons!

The LithoBreak Team

notes.title: LithoBreak - Episode 1 Release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38362143/7331ef519705e4c5f4af1109512903c82f29959d.png

Greetings Scientists,

August 10th is finally here, and we are very happy to announce the full release of Episode 1 of LithoBreak!

We want to thank our community and beta testers again, for helping us make LithoBreak a better experience for all. Your feedback has been extremely valuable, and we definitely can’t thank you enough.

Before jumping into the changes coming with the Episode 1 release, we want to share the current roadmap for the game with you:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38362143/4d6ea58d48efc2d8b3d1f344f167908bb46f0123.png

Releasing Episode 1 will not mean slower development on future episodes, or fewer updates to the game. We still have quite a ways to go, and are working as hard as ever to bring you exciting new content! Episode 2 is the next major milestone, and will be released with a number of awesome new features such as: energy management, multiplayer, factories, and more!

In the meantime, we welcome you back to LithoBreak Episode 1! If you do not own the game yet, now’s a great time to jump in as LithoBreak is currently 30% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1091030/LithoBreak/

As mentioned in our July Dev Log, quite a few changes are coming with the Episode 1 release, starting with a complete UI Rework.

https://i.imgur.com/MjDNJbD.gif

This rework includes a new Tablet UI with a sleeker and smoother interface, as well as new UI elements in almost every corner of the game. This ensures you have all the information you need without clogging up the screen!

https://i.imgur.com/wWx2dTI.gif

We have also included a brand new menu for in-game construction. Hovering your mouse over a building will give you its description, and you’ll be able to zoom in and out so all the information is available, no matter the size of your monitor.

https://i.imgur.com/WQ8CaKD.gif

A feature that’s been requested a lot by our community was a priority list for constructions. You’ve been heard loud and clear, we’re glad to announce that it’s coming with Episode 1! You can now sort the buildings in any order you want to ensure a smooth expansion of your mining operations. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38362143/f919f733cc778ec392c0eb1613a87e41fcc3abae.png

Another highly requested feature that we’re glad to introduce with this update is deconstructing buildings! But that’s not all;we are also laying the groundwork for adding parts durability to the game! Currently, the buildings are composed of various parts (20 to 80) that will eventually see a durability drop with use. In the future, durability will be affected by the materials used to craft the parts as well, leading to some parts being more reliable than others.

https://i.imgur.com/MYUhk4a.gif

All of the features we presented for the Closed Beta have finally made it to release! These include an improved save/load system, fully fledged custom settings for video output, and other tweaks and features. It’s time to experience the smoothest and most polished version of LithoBreak to date!

https://i.imgur.com/Ho5zDuZ.gif

That’s all for now folks, but there is still so much more to come! Thanks again for the constant support, and all the kind words. LithoBreak is moving along nicely and we’re very excited for the next steps of our journey!

Make sure to join our community on Discord to hear all the latest news about LithoBreak, and reach out to other players!

Catch you in the Verse,
Tau Ceti Labs

You can also follow us on:
Twitter: @LithoBreakGame
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/LithoBreakGame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/LithoBreakGame/

notes.title: July Dev Log - Closed Beta Changes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38362143/3f5986b6a8c968bbd06a9f05ce1f084408fa8299.png

Greetings, scientists! 

It’s been a bit since our last dev log because we wanted to keep the surprise, but now the Closed Beta is live, and we can share what LithoBreak’s development has been over the last few weeks!


https://i.imgur.com/MjDNJbD.gif
New UI Style
Our UI has seen massive improvements for the release of the Closed Beta, with the new UI style translated to the tablet! 
The UI overhaul we started a few weeks ago for the game is now nearing completion, the most recent upgrade being the tablet. Those UI changes mean migrating the game to thinner and sleeker borders, which are nicely complemented by brand new smooth and quick fade transitions between tablet tabs!


https://i.imgur.com/mFrPjoq.gif
Autosave and Save/Load Improvements
After listening to our Discord community’s feedback, we took the time to improve our saving and loading system, and we’re glad to announce it has been radiation-hardened and is now ready for service!

We pushed a lot of standardization efforts in our game development, meaning loading games between versions will be far more reliable. Allowing you to keep growing your mining operations after most game updates without starting over.

Additionally, we implemented a new autosave feature! It will save your game automatically between intervals. Players can customize the interval time and the number of saved files in the game settings.

Settings, you say?


https://i.imgur.com/IUrpUJ9.gif
Settings Menu
That’s correct; we have been working hard at adding a fully-fledged settings screen to LithoBreak! 

You can find this new Options menu on both the title screen and the in-game tablet, so you can switch settings on the fly if the need arises. This new menu will allow the game to run on a wider variety of devices and should cover most of the screen available to players!
You can also take advantage of the Options menu to rebind your keyboards to something that suits your style better.

Let us know if you’d like to see this added to the mining screen! We are always listening to incoming feedback on our Discord.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38362143/f919f733cc778ec392c0eb1613a87e41fcc3abae.png
Deconstruction & Parts Durability 
The latest feature we added to LithoBreak has been a highly requested one: Deconstructing buildings! You can now tear apart buildings you no longer want to make room for another production line or make your base more efficient or aesthetically appealing. 

Also, every building will now have a list of all the installed parts, anywhere between 20 and 80 parts per building. As the buildings are used, the HP percentages of the components will slowly drop, and some will need to be replaced! Better materials will lead to higher durability while building parts, and high durability parts will degrade a lot slower. More to come in the next Dev Logs.


https://i.imgur.com/Ho5zDuZ.gif
Polish to the Moon!
After many hours of hard work, we're glad to say that LithoBreak is looking better than ever! Everything has been revamped, upgraded, or tweaked from the station to the moon to make the game experience as appealing as possible.

Thanks to our awesome alpha testers, gameplay has been improved and is as smooth as it’s ever been. 

Next up will be some beta testing! Our Closed Beta session is running strong thanks to our incredible community, and we will share the results and improvements from that feedback in the next Dev Log. But before that, we want to give you all an opportunity to join in on the fun!

Until August 3rd, the Beta will be accessible to everyone through Steam! Head up to:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1091030/LithoBreak/

And join the playtest here! Share your feedback with us on Discord and chat with the devs and the rest of the Beta testers.

Thanks for joining us in this Dev Log, and we hope to see you in the next one! In the meantime, don’t miss out on LithoBreak’s development by following our socials:
Twitter: https://twitter.com/LithoBreakGame
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/LithoBreakGame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/LithoBreakGame/

Catch you in the Verse,
Tau Ceti Labs

notes.title: Materials Update
notes.notes:
The revamped mining experience has just gone live!  This comes with major overhauls to the core mining systems, including:

Materials
Every material is now of a pre-defined list with color codes, making it easier to differentiate between materials.  These changes allow easier development of future materials, and many more materials and material types will be coming soon.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38362143/113f021f1d1d7426420d4aef9ed25d4a2460b74e.png

Material routing
Through the updated UI, materials are now intuitively routed between buildings.  This gives a clearer picture of how the different materials are being moved through a base.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38362143/8bfb1ecc90d42228ec4d4aa6bcecf5cfe2a93525.png

Parts handling
How the parts are handled and saved on the back end have been reworked for performance reasons.  This mainly impacts the builder when there are hundreds of possible part locations to install parts into, as seen in the new title screen!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38362143/02092f9661fd56ef8cec5a26a9929746bed80eab.png

Thank you for your patience as we focused on rebuilding the mining foundation of LithoBreak.  Many more changes will be coming soon to build off this new foundation, including a revamped part production coming to the powder printer.  Later we will be extending the mining experience to include new types of materials like metals and fluids.

We hope you enjoy this update!
